name: @ai-eye/macos-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol server for macOS screen automation - gives AI agents visual access to native apps via Accessibility framework
author: AI Eye Team

scripts.build:swift: cd swift-helper && swift build -c release && mkdir -p ../dist/bin && cp .build/release/aieye-macos-helper ../dist/bin/
scripts.postinstall: cd swift-helper && swift build -c release && mkdir -p ../dist/bin && cp .build/release/aieye-macos-helper ../dist/bin/ || echo 'Swift build failed - macOS with Xcode Command Line Tools required'
